title: Environment-bound Tenant Connector routing and Staging transport ownership isolation

phases.objective: Make Connector routing environment-bound and fail closed while preventing Staging from stopping or reconfiguring the legacy Local Connector cloudflared service. connector.mad4b.com remains one shared Admin Recovery transport whose authority is resolved by the receiving environment runtime/database; no connector-dev hostname is introduced by this change.

e2e_journeys.actor: Tenant or API-credential caller through the environment control plane
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A /connector/:device_id proxy request resolved against the receiving environment database
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Candidate routes remain tenant/device routes only; admin_recovery is excluded unless an Admin principal supplies explicit recovery intent.
steps: Resolve environment from the receiving runtime and its configured database authority.
Resolve tenant, user, canonical device, and config from that environment database.
Load enabled route candidates for the resolved config.
Exclude admin_recovery routes for tenant/API-credential callers and for Admin callers without explicit recovery intent.
Forward only the selected eligible route and strip the control-plane recovery selector from the device request.
assertions: environment authority precedes tenant/device route selection
tenant and API-credential callers cannot receive admin_recovery as a fallback candidate
Admin authority alone does not enable recovery fallback without explicit recovery intent
recovery_intent is not forwarded to the local device
connector.mad4b.com remains a shared Admin Recovery transport rather than a tenant runtime route

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Connector installer emitted by Production or Staging control plane
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The generated connector environment binds policy and heartbeat callbacks to the same environment control plane; the Watchdog rejects missing or cross-environment heartbeat binding instead of defaulting to Production.
steps: Select only auth.mad4b.com for Production or dev.mad4b.com for Staging.
Persist CONNECTOR_ENVIRONMENT and CONNECTOR_CONTROL_PLANE_BASE_URL into the connector environment.
Derive policy and heartbeat URLs from that validated base URL.
Reject a configured control-plane URL whose hostname does not match the resolved environment.
Have the Watchdog validate CONNECTOR_ENVIRONMENT against CONNECTOR_HEARTBEAT_URL before sending authenticated state.
assertions: Staging connector callbacks cannot default to auth.mad4b.com
Production connector callbacks cannot target dev.mad4b.com
the Watchdog has no hard-coded Production heartbeat fallback
connector.mad4b.com is excluded from application hostname families but remains environment-bound through runtime/database/credential authority
connector-dev.mad4b.com is not introduced or required by this change
cross-environment Connector credential reuse is forbidden
no provider, DNS, live database, or Production deployment mutation is performed by this change

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Invoke-Staging-One-Click-Core.ps1 with windows_service, docker_sidecar, or disabled tunnel mode
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging manages only Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared or its own Docker sidecar and never stops, deletes, creates, reconfigures, or performs inactivity checks against the generic Local Connector cloudflared Windows service.
steps: Resolve the canonical Staging Windows service name as Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared.
Store the Staging tunnel token and log beneath C:\ProgramData\Mad4B\Staging\Cloudflared with restricted ACLs.
Quiesce only the Staging-owned Windows service and Staging-owned Docker sidecar before topology transitions.
Create or reconcile only Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared when windows_service mode is selected.
Verify process stability, LocalSystem ownership, token-file transport, HTTP/2 transport, and remote managed origin on the exact Staging service.
Leave the generic cloudflared service untouched as the backward-compatible Local Connector ownership boundary until a separately certified Local Connector service migration.
assertions: Staging source contains no Get-Service Cloudflared or Stop-Service Cloudflared mutation path
Staging source does not query Win32_Service Name='Cloudflared'
Staging creates and recovers only Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared
docker_sidecar selection does not stop the Local Connector Windows tunnel service
legacy Local Connector cloudflared ownership is preserved during this transition
Local Connector Watchdog can later consume CONNECTOR_CLOUDFLARED_SERVICE for a separately certified service namespace migration
no Cloudflare DNS/configuration mutation is performed by Staging One-Click
